enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Move arm. Move leg. Turn on back. Stretch. Yawn. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out bread. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Whisk. Pour into pan. Cook. Flip. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat. Drink. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the living room and vacuuming the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up items from floor. Place on sofa. Fluff pillows. Fold blanket. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Turn off vacuum. Unplug. Put away vacuum.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk to store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk to produce section. Pick up apples. Put in basket. Walk to dairy section. Pick up milk. Put in basket. Walk to checkout. Pay. Bag items. Walk home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and reading on the bed with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Adjust position. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Close book. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a walk in the park
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk to park. Walk on path. Look at trees. Stop. Sit on bench. Look around. Stand up. Walk around pond. Pick up leaf. Throw leaf. Walk home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Take out pan. Turn on stove. Add water to pot. Boil water. Add pasta. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Drain pasta. Add sauce. Place on plate. Sit at table. Eat. Drink. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and browsing the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Text. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait. Turn on shower. Get in. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the phone and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Use phone. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Move arm. Move leg. Turn on back. Stretch. Yawn. Continue sleeping.
